title: The Closest Thing We Have to Alien Technology
summary: Veritasium explains how ASML's EUV lithography machines make the most advanced computer chips, covering the engineering of the light source, mirrors and the supply chain around them. It is a long-form explainer on the world's most complex commercial machine.
why: HN commenters recommend it as the accessible deep-dive on EUV lithography and why chip manufacturing is so hard.

quote.text: The whole process was deep magic to me before I watched that video.
